review_notes: I read the whole file. The definitions are `normPow`, the private `diagonalIdele`, `shift` and `unitaryPart`. `normPow` is built from the library's own `ideleClassNorm.cpowCharacter`, so it reuses an existing construction. `diagonalIdele` is private and is used only to build a continuous section `ℝ → ideles` in the proof of `exists_norm_apply_eq_rpow`. I grepped the Tau Ceti tree and found no other diagonal-idele or real-parametrised idele construction. The nearest candidate is in `Ideles/Norm/Units.lean`, which works place by place and is not the same object. `shift` and `unitaryPart` are specific Hecke-character notions. They are not duplicates of anything I found in the supplied Mathlib, Batteries or core sources, and I did not do an exhaustive search of those roots. I did not find a clear competing concept or a concrete cost from duplication, so I abstain.
